title: 分級測驗 Placement — 8 題判定 A1 / A2 / B1
how: 學生用語音逐題回答。Agent 計分：0–2 對 → A1 從頭；3–5 → A2；6–8 → B1。每題答對給 1 分（意思清楚＋時態大致對就算對）。

questions.q: What is your name? Where are you from?
What do you do every morning?
What did you do last night?
What are you doing these days?
What are you going to do next month?
Which is better, summer or winter? Why?
questions.qZh: 夏天冬天哪個好？為什麼？

questions.q: Have you ever tried something new? What happened?
